experiment: Experiment 82.3.3 PA-DGPL — Patient-Adaptive Decision-Gain Prompt Learning
selection: Historical val=test. Strict test ACC improvement. Keep earliest tie.
preprocessing: Historical pre-CV RFE and scaling, transductive graph, train/test arrays unchanged.

class_statistics.estimation: Initialize with byte-exact E82.3 fit on legal E61 epoch10 training rows; explicit post-evaluation EMA follows below.

ema.compute: CPU float64 legal CAM projection using the original spectrum cache, then observed first and uncentered second moments.
ema.initialization: Start with E82.3 mean and stable inference variance exactly. Derive raw second moment from E82.3 unbiased variance times (n-1)/n plus squared mean.
ema.variance: Clamp roundoff in second minus mean squared at zero and apply n/(n-1) by class before E82.3 stabilization. Inference uses float32.
ema.order: Train, four optimizer steps, evaluate once and select Best with prior EMA, freeze Best if selected, update EMA once using captured legal eval CAM, persist post-update Latest.

decision.performance: Require all 10 folds audited, ACC higher than DARG, BA at least DARG, specified SEN/Prob-AUC floors and positive patient net correction.
decision.mechanism: Require all 10 folds audited, nonzero gate and actual residual, main gradients in all four new parameter groups, T1 loses at least one correct patient and fold-mean ACC, and positive pooled test true-class Margin change.
decision.mechanism_partial: When neither group qualifies for GO, require G2 Mechanism GO plus higher paired ACC and positive net patient correction versus G1. If neither group exceeds DARG ACC, NO-GO takes precedence.
decision.go: At least one group passes both Performance GO and Mechanism GO.
